channel.title: CVE Daily — AI Curated
channel.description: Today's vulnerability landscape is heavily concentrated in desktop operating systems, cloud security, and network device infrastructure, with substantial impacts also observed in web applications and database middleware. The majority of flaws involve memory corruption techniques such as heap-based buffer overflows and use-after-free errors, alongside injection and deserialization vulnerabilities that enable unauthenticated remote code execution and privilege escalation. These critical weaknesses predominantly affect Microsoft Windows kernel components, Azure cloud services, SQL Server, and ASP.NET Core, while also extending to third-party tools like OpenSSH and AI inference frameworks. Collectively, they present a severe risk of full system compromise and lateral movement across modern enterprise environments.
